DMSScript.Name: SLC-DH-AS-ManageSharePointSecret
DMSScript.Description: Runs SharePoint operations with the source credentials this script declares (Action Execute, used by DocumentHub itself). Administrative actions, for which Request is ignored: RestoreAssignments declares every source's credential again after a package upgrade; MigrateLocal or MigrateLocalWithGlobal is the explicit agent-local migration to native credentials (stop old writers first and run on every agent).
DMSScript.Author: JSL
